description: This is a shell script intended for automating end-to-end testing or deployment workflows for a project related to OpenClaw on Parallels virtualization. It manages VM snapshots, installs dependencies, runs various phases of setup and testing, and produces a JSON summary of the process outcomes.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Prints a message prefixed with '==>' to standard output.

methods.name: artifact_label
methods.description: Determines the label for the artifact based on whether TARGET_PACKAGE_SPEC is set.

methods.name: extract_package_build_commit_from_tgz
methods.description: Extracts the 'commit' value from a package's build info JSON inside a tarball.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints a warning message to standard error.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message to standard error and exits the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary directories and kills the server process if running.

methods.name: shell_quote
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe use in shell commands.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: resolve_vm_name
methods.description: Resolves the VM name based on requested name, fallback, and available VM list.

methods.name: resolve_snapshot_info
methods.description: Selects the most appropriate snapshot for the VM based on hints and status.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Detects the host IP address, or uses the explicitly provided one.

methods.name: is_host_port_free
methods.description: Checks if a given port is free by attempting to bind a socket.

methods.name: allocate_host_port
methods.description: Finds an available host port by binding to port 0.

methods.name: resolve_host_port
methods.description: Resolves the port to use, either explicit or dynamically allocated.

methods.name: guest_exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the VM.

methods.name: wait_for_vm_status
methods.description: Waits until the VM reaches an expected status.

methods.name: wait_for_guest_ready
methods.description: Waits until the VM guest OS is responsive.

methods.name: restore_snapshot
methods.description: Restores a VM snapshot and possibly powers it on.

methods.name: bootstrap_guest
methods.description: Updates package list and installs curl and ca-certificates inside the VM.

methods.name: resolve_latest_version
methods.description: Retrieves the latest version of openclaw from npm.

methods.name: current_build_commit
methods.description: Reads the current build's commit hash from build-info.json.

methods.name: acquire_build_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent multiple builds from running simultaneously.

methods.name: release_build_lock
methods.description: Removes the build lock directory.

methods.name: ensure_current_build
methods.description: Ensures the build output matches the current HEAD by building if necessary.

methods.name: extract_package_version_from_tgz
methods.description: Extracts the package version from a tarball.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Creates a tarball of the current build or from a target package spec.

methods.name: verify_target_version
methods.description: Verifies that the built package contains the expected version.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts a local HTTP server to serve the build tarball.

methods.name: install_latest_release
methods.description: Installs the latest openclaw release inside the VM.

methods.name: install_main_tgz
methods.description: Downloads and installs the main package tarball into the VM.

methods.name: verify_version_contains
methods.description: Checks if the openclaw version inside VM matches expected version substring.

methods.name: run_ref_onboard
methods.description: Runs onboarding with reference input.

methods.name: start_gateway_background
methods.description: Starts the OpenClaw gateway in the background inside the VM.

methods.name: show_gateway_status_compat
methods.description: Displays the status of the gateway in a compatible way.

methods.name: verify_local_turn
methods.description: Sets the model and checks local agent turn.

methods.name: write_summary_json
methods.description: Outputs a JSON summary of the test run to a file.

methods.name: run_fresh_main_lane
methods.description: Executes the phases for a fresh main lane: restore snapshot, bootstrap, install, onboard, start gateway, verify status.

methods.name: run_upgrade_lane
methods.description: Executes the phases for an upgrade lane: restore snapshot, upgrade, install, onboard, start gateway, verify status.
